key.name: position
key.description: Compatibility key for older cached extension code. The tray is always shown in the top bar.

key.name: grid-columns
key.description: Maximum number of columns in the hidden-icons flyout.

key.name: grid-rows
key.description: Compatibility key for older cached extension code. The new flyout wraps and scrolls automatically.

key.name: auto-fit
key.description: Compatibility key for older cached extension code. The new flyout always fits rows automatically.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Compatibility key for older cached extension code. The new tray uses 40 pixel cells and a separate popup icon size.

key.name: popup-icon-size
key.description: Logical pixel size used for icons inside the hidden-icons flyout.

key.name: default-placement
key.description: Whether newly discovered indicators appear in the flyout or remain on the top bar.

key.name: app-rules
key.description: Maps stable indicator identities to overflow or panel placement.

key.name: known-indicators
key.description: Previously observed indicator identity, display name, and icon name tuples used by preferences.
